title: InteractionRecord
description: One archived player-NPC interaction, appended to Adventure.history at play-time by the narrator. The interaction/result payloads are stored opaquely here: their strict shapes are owned and validated by the npc layer, so the store never couples to npc's field set.

interaction.description: The player's interaction payload (npc/interaction.json shape; stored opaquely).

result.description: The NPC decision payload (npc/interaction-result.json shape; stored opaquely).
